attchmntText: Cambridge Technology Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cambridge Technology Enterprises Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board took note of the completion of the loan receivable assignment from wholly owned subsidiary FA Software Services Private Limited to Aglow Financial Services Private Limited. The Company received Rs. 40,00,000 as consideration for this transfer. The Board also approved the disinvestment of its entire 100% shareholding in FA Software Services Private Limited. This involves the sale of 10,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each to AKIT IT Consulting Private Limited for Rs. 1,00,000. Upon completion, FA Software Services Private Limited will cease to be a wholly owned subsidiary. The Share Purchase Agreement has not yet been executed.

Limited Review Report on the Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 issued by M/s. Assignment/Transfer of loan receivable from FA Software Services Private Limited to Aglow Financial Services Private Limited. 4. Disinvestment of 100% Shareholding in FA Software Services Private Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
